breakdown.description: The prompt uses rpm directly as angular velocity in P = T ω, even though ω must be in radians per second.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states 'Calculate the angular velocity using the formula ω = 2π(rpm/60)' and then uses this ω in P = T·ω. It does not repeat the incorrect instruction to substitute rpm directly as ω. This aligns with the ground truth, which also specifies ω = 2π(rpm/60) without the erroneous direct substitution of rpm.
